parameters.query:
UPDATE bookings.memberships
SET
  plan_name          = COALESCE(NULLIF($1,''), plan_name),
  monthly_rate       = CASE WHEN $2::text <> '' THEN $2::numeric ELSE monthly_rate END,
  policy_template    = COALESCE(NULLIF($3,''), policy_template),
  notice_period_days = CASE WHEN $4::text <> '' THEN $4::int ELSE notice_period_days END,
  notes              = CASE WHEN $5::text IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF($5,'') ELSE notes END,
  updated_at         = NOW()
WHERE id = $6::uuid
  AND tenant_id = $7
RETURNING id AS membership_id, plan_name, customer_id, policy_template, monthly_rate, notice_period_days, notes;

options.queryReplacement:
={{ [
  $('Webhook: Update Membership').first().json.body?.plan_name || '',
  String($('Webhook: Update Membership').first().json.body?.monthly_rate ?? ''),
  $('Webhook: Update Membership').first().json.body?.policy_template || '',
  String($('Webhook: Update Membership').first().json.body?.notice_period_days ?? ''),
  $('Webhook: Update Membership').first().json.body?.notes ?? null,
  $('Webhook: Update Membership').first().json.body?.membership_id || '',
  parseInt($('Webhook: Update Membership').first().json.body?.tenant_id || '0')
] }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE bookings.customers
SET
  full_name  = COALESCE(NULLIF($1,''), full_name),
  email      = COALESCE(NULLIF($2,''), email),
  phone      = COALESCE(NULLIF($3,''), phone),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $4::uuid
  AND tenant_id = $5
RETURNING id, full_name, email, phone;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO bookings.customer_interactions
  (customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone,
   booking_id, booking_date, room_name,
   subject, interaction_type, notes, timestamp, staff_member, tenant_id)
VALUES
  ($1::uuid, $2, $3, '',
   NULL, NULL, NULL,
   'Membership details updated',
   'membership',
   'Plan: ' || $4 || ', Rate: £' || COALESCE($5::text,'—') || '/mo',
   NOW(), $6, $7)
RETURNING id;
